mandate: Track B higher-return research-only ETF variants

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_cash_cap_20
candidates.hypothesis: Lower idle cash in non-stress states may raise return without breaking defense.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher return and beta; slightly worse drawdown/CVaR.
candidates.success_criteria: Return improves with drawdown above -22% and Sharpe >= 0.85.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if return remains near Track A or stress drawdown deteriorates materially.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_cash_cap_15_good_20_neutral
candidates.hypothesis: More targeted cash reduction in good states may improve return with less neutral-state risk.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Lower BIL with moderate drawdown increase.
candidates.success_criteria: Return improves and 2x cost Sharpe remains >= 0.85.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if neutral-state losses dominate the improvement.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_cash_cap_10_good_18_neutral
candidates.hypothesis: A stronger cash cap tests whether 9% return is reachable without stress changes.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher beta and larger drawdown risk.
candidates.success_criteria: CAGR approaches 9% with max drawdown above -22%.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if drawdown or CVaR worsens faster than return improves.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_offense_boost_10
candidates.hypothesis: Small offense scaling may lift return while retaining Track A state timing.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher offense and turnover; may be mostly beta.
candidates.success_criteria: Return improves with Sharpe near Track A and stress unchanged.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if beta explains nearly all incremental return.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_offense_boost_20
candidates.hypothesis: Stronger offense scaling tests the mandate boundary.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher return potential; materially higher beta/drawdown.
candidates.success_criteria: CAGR near 9% with max drawdown above -22%.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if 2x costs or CVaR erase the case.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_cash10_offense10
candidates.hypothesis: Combining cash reduction and mild offense boost may reach mandate with controlled stress behavior.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher return; likely higher beta and CVaR.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if stress or neutral-state behavior collapses.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_cash10_offense20
candidates.hypothesis: Strongest Track A-timed overlay tests upper edge of drawdown tolerance.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Highest Track A-timed return attempt; may fail drawdown or beta attribution.
candidates.success_criteria: CAGR >= 9% and 2x costs survive without drawdown below -22%.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if it is just higher beta with no benchmark edge.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_rerisk_4w
candidates.hypothesis: Faster re-risking after stress exits may reduce cash drag.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: May improve recoveries; can be path dependent.
candidates.success_criteria: Improves recovery_confirmed/recovery_fragile metrics without stress damage.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if benefit is narrow and not robust.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_vol_throttled
candidates.hypothesis: Higher offense should be disabled during high realized SPY volatility.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Lower drawdown/CVaR than strongest overlay, lower return.
candidates.success_criteria: Retains much of aggressive return with better tail behavior.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if it gives up return without meaningful risk control.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_turnover_banded
candidates.hypothesis: Aggressive weights may survive costs if small weekly changes are ignored.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Lower turnover and cost; may lag re-risking.
candidates.success_criteria: 2x and 3x cost sensitivity improves versus unbanded overlay.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if banding worsens timing more than it saves cost.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_blend_static_growth_30
candidates.hypothesis: A simple explicit risk budget may explain return gain versus timing.
candidates.success_criteria: Improves return with acceptable drawdown and transparent beta attribution.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if a simple benchmark dominates it.

candidates.name: track_b_aggressive_blend_static_growth_50
candidates.hypothesis: A more aggressive static blend tests whether 9-10% is mainly beta.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Higher return potential; likely mostly beta and larger drawdown.
candidates.success_criteria: CAGR >= 9%, drawdown above -22%, and not dominated by aggressive benchmarks.
candidates.kill_criteria: Reject if return comes mostly from equity beta or drawdown exceeds mandate.
